name: Ben-hail
overview: Ben-hail was a male official serving under King Jehoshaphat. His primary role, as recorded in Scripture, was to be sent out as a teacher during Jehoshaphat's reign. Beyond this official capacity, no additional personal details such as tribal affiliation or family background are provided.
namesAndTitles: The name Ben-hail means 'son of wealth' or 'son of strength,' reflecting Hebrew roots that emphasize either prosperity or power. This proper name is not indicated as given directly by God but is recorded in 2 Chronicles 17:7.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Ben-hail beyond what is noted in his official capacity. There are no details about his relatives or tribe in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Ben-hail's significance lies in his role as an emissary of King Jehoshaphat, sent to teach the people. This demonstrates the king's commitment to instructing the nation in God's law and maintaining spiritual order. Ben-hail's service contributes to the broader biblical theme of godly leadership promoting education and faithfulness among Israel.
